scope: Production pointer callbacks in DOM-stub VM; synthetic callback events, not browser trusted input

bots.name: repeat
bots.note: Grab the visible handle and repeat a 104 model-pixel upward stroke.
bots.chanceFormula: 80 orientations / 1800 orientations; endpoint and fixed length constraints reduce this bound

bots.name: cycle
bots.note: Grab the visible handle; cycle up/right/down/left strokes of 104 model pixels.
bots.chanceFormula: 80 orientations / 1800 orientations; endpoint and fixed length constraints reduce this bound

bots.name: random
bots.note: Grab the visible handle; choose a uniform angle over 360° and length uniformly 60–190 model pixels. It reads no answer, slope, or gap.
bots.chanceFormula: 8° / 360°; random length and endpoint constraints reduce this bound
